What it is (*example*): cut off before a complete variant: `NM_000059.4:c.68_69` (range, no edit)
a bare variant body, no transcript/gene/accession: `c.68_69delAG`
misplaced or truncated version, or a missing prefix with no unique data match: `NM_000059/4:c.68del` (slash in place of the version dot)
malformed or non-standard edit operation: `NM_000059.4:c.68AG>T` (multi-base reference in a substitution)
extra characters after a complete variant, or several run together: `NM_000059.4:c.68delAG;c.70A>G`
legitimate HGVS the biocommons grammar rejects: `NM_000059.4:c.(67+1_68-1)_(70+1_71-1)del` (uncertain-range deletion)
an insertion given as a base count, not a sequence: `NM_000059.4:c.68_69ins5` (position and length recoverable; inserted bases not)
